name: Chef Grual
summary: In Darkshire, Chef Grual keeps the Scarlet Raven Tavern's kitchen working. He feeds the Night Watch and weary travelers, though some ingredients raise eyebrows.

sections.title: Cooking Under Siege
sections.body: Darkshire's cook works with scarce supplies. Highwaymen, wolves, and undead harass the roads from Westfall and Stormwind, leaving fresh provisions hard to find. Grual makes do with what the wilderness offers. He cooks wolf flank and meat scavenged by local adventurers, using whatever reaches his kitchen.

sections.title: Secret Ingredients
sections.body: Chef Grual is known for Dusky Crab Cakes and seasoned wolf kabobs. Duskwood lies far from the coast, so his crab cakes contain gooey legs from the local Venom Web Spiders. Whether patrons know what they are eating or prefer not to ask, Grual keeps the kitchen running without apology.

faq.answer: Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. He prepares meals for the town's defenders, travelers, and refugees hiding from Duskwood's dangers.

faq.q: Where can I find Chef Grual?
faq.answer: Chef Grual works in the back room and kitchen of the Scarlet Raven Tavern in central Darkshire, along the southern edge of the main road.

faq.q: What are Dusky Crab Cakes actually made of?
aliases: what is in dusky crab cakes
faq.answer: Dusky Crab Cakes contain gooey legs from the Venom Web Spiders infesting the surrounding forests. Grual minces them into patties that mimic seafood.

faq.q: What quests does Chef Grual offer?
faq.answer: Chef Grual asks travelers to gather wolf flanks for his seasoned wolf kabobs and spider legs for his Dusky Crab Cakes. He also cooks Dusky Crab Cakes for Jitters, a starving man hiding in Duskwood.
Jitters has hidden in a Duskwood ghost town for weeks, living on grubs and weeds. Starving for decent food, he sends travelers to Grual for Dusky Crab Cakes.

faq.q: Is Grual affiliated with the Night Watch?
faq.answer: Chef Grual is a civilian cook, not a guardsman. His kitchen feeds the Night Watch and local militia as they face constant siege.

angles.text: Grual shows how a cook in an isolated region makes use of local wildlife, whether it walks or skitters through the trees.
At the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, Grual keeps Alliance defenders fed despite the shortage of regular supply caravans from Stormwind.
Like many of Darkshire's remaining residents, Grual endures the horrors of the shadowed woods with grim, stubborn resilience and practical skill.
